indicator.subject: Mathematics
indicator.content_standard: B4.3.2.1 Describe the position of objects in space using the cardinal points
indicator.objective: Tell the position and motion of objects in space using the cardinal points north, south, east and west

skills.description: Identify North, South, East, and West on a compass or grid.
Describe where an object is relative to another using cardinal points.
Describe the movement of an object from one point to another using cardinal points.

spec.difficultyPlan: 20 questions: 5 at difficulty 1, 7 at difficulty 2, 5 at difficulty 3, 3 at difficulty 4.

questions.stem: On a standard compass, which direction is opposite to East?
Which direction is at the top of a standard map or grid?
Point A is at (2, 3) and Point B is at (2, 5). What is the position of B relative to A?
hints: Both have x=2, so they are on the same vertical line.
B has a larger y-value, so it is higher.
questions.explanation: Moving from A to B means increasing the y-value, which is moving North.
questions.misconception: Saying East because the y-axis is vertical.

questions.stem: To move from (1, 1) to (1, 4), in which direction do you travel?
questions.explanation: Moving up on a grid is moving North.

questions.stem: If you are facing North, what is to your right?
questions.explanation: When facing North, East is to the right.

questions.stem: Start at (0, 0). Move 3 squares North, then 2 squares East. What is the new x-coordinate?
questions.explanation: Moving East increases the x-coordinate by 2. x = 0 + 2 = 2.

questions.stem: The school is East of Kofi's house. The hospital is North of Kofi's house. What is the position of the school relative to the hospital?
hints: Draw a grid. Kofi's house is at (0,0).
School is at (2,0). Hospital is at (0,2).
From hospital to school, you go right and down.
questions.explanation: The school is South-East of the hospital.

questions.stem: A pupil starts at (2, 2). They move 3 squares West and 4 squares South. What is the new y-coordinate?
A point is at (3, 4). It moves to (3, 1). Which direction did it move?
questions.explanation: Decreasing the y-coordinate means moving South.

questions.stem: If point T is at (4, 2) and point A is at (4, 6), what is the position of A relative to T?
Start at (1, 1). Move 2 squares East, then 3 squares North. What is the new x-coordinate?
Describe the position of the school relative to the market if the market is at (2, 3) and the school is at (5, 3).
questions.explanation: The school is East of the market because the x-coordinate is larger (5 > 2) and the y-coordinate is the same.

criteria.description: States the school is East of the market.
Explains that the y-coordinates are the same and x is larger.

questions.stem: You are at (0, 0). You move 4 squares North, then 3 squares East, then 4 squares South. Where are you now?
questions.explanation: After North and South, the y-coordinate returns to 0. The x-coordinate moved 3 East. So, (3, 0).

questions.stem: Start at (2, 3). Move 4 squares South, then 2 squares East. What is the new position? (Enter as x,y)
Point P is North-West of point T. Point T is South of point A. What is the position of P relative to A?
hints: P is above and left of T.
questions.explanation: P is North-West of T. Since T is South of A, P is still North-West of A.

questions.stem: Describe the path from (1, 2) to (1, 5) and then to (4, 5).
hints: What changes in the first step?
What changes in the second step?
questions.explanation: First, move 3 squares North (y increases from 2 to 5). Then, move 3 squares East (x increases from 1 to 4).

questions.stem: A pupil starts at (1, 1). They move 3 East, then 2 North, then 3 West. What is the new x-coordinate?
hints: East adds to x, West subtracts.

questions.stem: If the library is (4, 5) and the canteen is (4, 8), what is the direction from the library to the canteen, and what is the direction from the canteen to the library?
hints: Same x, larger y is North.
Same x, smaller y is South.
questions.explanation: From library to canteen: North (y increases). From canteen to library: South (y decreases).

criteria.description: States North from library to canteen.
States South from canteen to library.

questions.stem: Start at (2, 2). Move 2 North, 3 East, 4 South, and 3 West. What is the final y-coordinate?
hints: Only North and South change y.
questions.explanation: y = 2 + 2 - 4 = 0? No, 2+2=4, 4-4=0. Let me re-read. Start y=2. Move 2 North -> y=4. Move 4 South -> y=0. So final y is 0.
